+    private class NodeFrame<P : TrieLeaf>(val node: TrieNode<P>, val path: List<Int>, var next: Int = -1)
+    /** A lazy DFS does not materialize the whole tree before the sample cap. */
+    private fun <P : TrieLeaf> cells(root: TrieNode<P>): Sequence<Pair<List<Int>, P>> = sequence {
+        val stack = ArrayDeque<NodeFrame<P>>()
+        stack.addLast(NodeFrame(root, emptyList()))
+        while (stack.isNotEmpty()) {
+            val frame = stack.peekLast()
+            if (frame.next == -1) {
+                frame.next = 0
+                if (!frame.node.leaf.isEmpty) yield(frame.path to frame.node.leaf)
+            }
+            val accessors = frame.node.accessorData
+            if (accessors == null || frame.next == accessors.size) stack.removeLast()
+            else {
+                val index = frame.next++
+                stack.addLast(NodeFrame(frame.node.childData!![index], frame.path + accessors[index]))
+            }
+        }
+    }

+    private fun limitedFacts(ap: ApManager, facts: Facts): Map<String, Any?> {
+        val members = ArrayList<Map<String, Any?>>()
+        var truncated = false
+        fun add(p: Pattern, protected: Boolean): Boolean {
+            if (members.size == 64) { truncated = true; return false }
+            members += obj("fact" to tracePattern(ap, p), "protected" to protected)
+            return true
+        }
+        when (facts) {
+            is Reach -> add(ap.zero.toPattern(), false)
+            is FlowTree -> for ((path, _) in cells(facts.root)) {
+                if (!add(Pattern(PathFact(facts.base, path, facts.tail, MarkSlot.Star(facts.markExclusion)), facts.exclusion), false)) break
+            }
+            is TaintTree -> outer@ for ((path, leaf) in cells(facts.root)) {
+                var mask = facts.nonSubsumable
+                for (accessor in path) mask = mask?.child(accessor)
+                for (id in leaf.exact.data) if (!add(Pattern(PathFact(facts.base, path, Tail.EXACT,
+                        MarkSlot.Concrete(TaintMark(id))), ExclusionSet.Empty),
+                        mask?.leaf?.exact?.let { TaintMark(id) in it } == true)) break@outer
+                for (id in leaf.any.data) if (!add(Pattern(PathFact(facts.base, path, facts.anyTail,
+                        MarkSlot.Concrete(TaintMark(id))), facts.exclusion),
+                        mask?.leaf?.any?.let { TaintMark(id) in it } == true)) break@outer
+            }
+        }
+        return obj("kind" to when (facts) { is Reach -> "REACH"; is FlowTree -> "FLOW"; is TaintTree -> "TAINT" },
+            "layer" to facts.layer.name, "members" to members, "truncated" to truncated)
+    }

+    private fun encodedPattern(ap: ApManager, p: Pattern, encodedBase: Map<String, Any?>): Map<String, Any?> = obj(

+    private fun base(b: AccessPathBase): Map<String, Any?> = when (b) {
+        AccessPathBase.Zero -> obj("kind" to "ZERO")
+        AccessPathBase.This -> obj("kind" to "THIS")
+        AccessPathBase.ClassStatic -> obj("kind" to "STATIC")
+        AccessPathBase.Return -> obj("kind" to "RETURN")
+        AccessPathBase.Exception -> obj("kind" to "EXCEPTION")
+        is AccessPathBase.Argument -> obj("kind" to "ARGUMENT", "index" to b.idx)
+        is AccessPathBase.LocalVar -> obj("kind" to "LOCAL", "index" to b.idx)
+        is AccessPathBase.Constant -> obj("kind" to "CONSTANT", "type" to b.typeName, "value" to b.value)
+        is AccessPathBase.CleanerTemporary -> error("A temporary cannot reach a diagnostic summary")
+    }

+    private fun accessor(ap: ApManager, id: Int): Map<String, Any?> = when (val a = ap.accessors.accessor(id)) {
+        is FieldAccessor -> obj("kind" to "FIELD", "owner" to a.className, "name" to a.fieldName, "type" to a.fieldType)
+        is ClassStaticAccessor -> obj("kind" to "CLASS", "type" to a.typeName)
+        ElementAccessor -> obj("kind" to "ELEMENT")
+        else -> error("Unsupported diagnostic accessor: $a")
+    }

+    private fun mark(ap: ApManager, atom: TaintMark): Map<String, Any?> = synchronized(ap.marks) {
+        when (val key = ap.marks.key(atom)) {
+            MarkAtomKey.ControlZero -> obj("kind" to "ZERO")
+            is MarkAtomKey.Group -> obj("kind" to "GROUP", "group" to (internerKey(ap.marks, "groups", key.id.value) as GroupName).encoded)
+            is MarkAtomKey.Full -> {
+                val full = internerKey(ap.marks, "fulls", key.mark.full.value) as FullKey
+                obj("kind" to "FULL", "group" to full.group.encoded, "name" to full.name)
+            }
+        }
+    }

+    /** Read existing immutable keys only; never call group()/full()/initial() or create atom IDs. */
+    private fun internerKey(table: MarkTable, name: String, index: Int): Any {
+        val interner = readField(table, name)
+        val keys = readField(checkNotNull(interner), "keys") as List<*>
+        return checkNotNull(keys[index])
+    }
+    private fun optionalLong(value: Any, name: String): Long? = try { readField(value, name) as Long }
+        catch (_: NoSuchFieldException) { null }
+    private fun readField(value: Any, name: String): Any? = value.javaClass.getDeclaredField(name).let {
+        it.isAccessible = true; it.get(value)
+    }
+    private fun obj(vararg pairs: Pair<String, Any?>): MutableMap<String, Any?> = linkedMapOf(*pairs)
+    private fun digest(s: String): String = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(s.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
+        .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 255) }
+    private fun write(path: Path, value: Any?) {
+        val temporary = path.resolveSibling(path.fileName.toString() + ".tmp")
+        Files.writeString(temporary, json(value) + "\n", StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW)
+        Files.move(temporary, path, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE)
+    }
+    private fun json(value: Any?): String = when (value) {
+        null -> "null"
+        is String -> buildString {
+            append('"')
+            for (c in value) when (c) {
+                '"' -> append("\\\"")
+                '\\' -> append("\\\\")
+                '\n' -> append("\\n")
+                '\r' -> append("\\r")
+                '\t' -> append("\\t")
+                else -> if (c.code < 32) append("\\u%04x".format(c.code)) else append(c)
+            }
+            append('"')
+        }
+        is Boolean, is Number -> value.toString()
+        is Map<*, *> -> value.entries.sortedBy { it.key as String }.joinToString(prefix = "{", postfix = "}") {
+            json(it.key as String) + ":" + json(it.value)
+        }
+        is Collection<*> -> value.joinToString(prefix = "[", postfix = "]") { json(it) }
+        else -> error("Unsupported diagnostic JSON value: ${value.javaClass.name}")
+    }

```text
Bind to receiver:    this.* / FLOW N
Read this.H.*:       result.[any] / FLOW D

```

The source permits parallel backward routes. The following is a constructive possible route through the selected models, not an exported actual backward trace:
